content: shaderc vendoring: no installed CMake config (find_package(shaderc CONFIG) unsupported per upstream issues #1369/vcpkg#23208). CMake options SHADERC_SKIP_TESTS/EXAMPLES/INSTALL/EXECUTABLES/COPYRIGHT_CHECK, SHADERC_ENABLE_HLSL (default ON, should be OFF per D-09), SHADERC_ENABLE_WGSL_OUTPUT (default OFF). Nested submodules via third_party/CMakeLists.txt: spirv-headers -> spirv-tools -> glslang, add_subdirectory order. DEPS file pins exact commits for each.
